summary: News of a baby: News of a baby reaches the family and {the parent-to-be} asks the player for help, a visit or a promise.
realLife: One life: A college junior of 19 told her mother first and asked her to tell the family. One aunt kept the secret then told others, causing a rift with her mother; other aunts were hurt but threw a baby shower. The family's blessing came before the birth. Another: A baby born at about 28 weeks in the Davenport, Iowa, area. Staff limited visitors, so only Kelly's mother was at the birth. A prayer chain started by a grandmother helped, the baby avoided intensive care, and he went home after two days. Another: A study of hunter-gatherers in Congo found babies had about eight regular hands-on caregivers besides their mothers, with help arriving within seconds of a cry. Researchers argue that parents without that circle, mostly in Western homes, face more isolation and postpartum depression.
